scope: Use Vercel-only lightweight packaging override; preserve full local npm build, regression, CI and all approved source evidence.
riskAnalysis: Build success proves only static packaging smoke checks. Full local and CI STRICT verification remain unchanged. Normal automatic Preview may be READY before CI; it must not be used for paid activation or called qualified until all exact-source gates pass. Package.json remains byte-identical to approved source. An initial local candidate failed ENG_SOURCE_DRIFT and was narrowed before publication; evidence locks are not rewritten.

threatModel.assets: Exact release identity, source fingerprint, provider credentials and unchanged full verification gates.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Vercel packaging versus local STRICT, GitHub CI and authorized reviewed Preview usage.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale lock, silently skipped full CI, leaked environment, failed child reported as success or build success presented as acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Fixed offline smoke args, real assertRelease, runner included in source fingerprint, filtered environment,60second timeout and explicit no-qualification/no-publication receipt.

rollback: Restore previous normalBhMc Preview alias; revert packaging-only change on feature branch after review. Main and Production stay unchanged.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Malformed smoke child status fails closed and cannot produce a passing build receipt.
negativePaths.stale-state: Real release lock assertion precedes smoke execution and refuses drift.
negativePaths.concurrency: No new shared state; one bounded child, no paid execution or reservation.
negativePaths.cancellation: Child interruption or signal fails packaging; existing runtime cancellation unchanged.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Smoke timeout or spawn error returns failure, without retry.
negativePaths.api-outage: Smoke tests are offline and require no provider or network response.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Build receipt explicitly grants no qualification or publication; owner controllers unchanged.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No model requests, new service or financial authority; only removes duplicate compute.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Any failed smoke stage suppresses success receipt; full CI still independently required.

defects.rootCause: Vercel npm build reran all worker regressions already required by fullCI, consuming92percent of latest buildtime.
defects.detectionGap: Build command inherited full regression as packaging, without separate cost/duration review.
defects.regression: Fixed smoke list and failure propagation tested; unchanged full npmtest/preflight/CI asserted.
defects.historicalPrevention: Separate packaging completion from engineering acceptance and measure deployed build duration.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing deployment process, one fixed smoke runner; no new orchestration or dependencies.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Unchanged lockfile and dependencies; existing Node runtime and offline harness.
proactiveReview.threats: False qualification, fingerprint drift, secret leakage or silent child failure.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Lock error, test failure, process signal or timeout all fail closed without retry.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Focused tests cover stale lock, nonzero exit, timeout/error and signal plus secret stripping.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate WorkQA and EngineeringAuditor review source and verification before featurepublication.
proactiveReview.recovery: Prior qualified normal Preview remains rollback target; no paid authorization carried forward.
proactiveReview.readiness: Local smoke4 andfocused6 passed; frozenSTRICT and remote qualification remain pending.
